narrative: On the part. A narrow part, soft at the head from other men's hands. Eight speech-marks run down it. The cues at the left edge are rubbed through to the fibre. On the part. The eighth speech-mark is still dark. The cue beside it is a hole the width of a thumb.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the head of the roll and did not invent a cue to fill the holes.

entities.name: the old Knave
entities.context: Shown on part in Eight lines on the baton
